cgu.title: Terms of Use

s1.heading: 1. Purpose
s1.body: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the Wilmet Trucks platform, which connects professional sellers of commercial vehicles (partners, referrers, suppliers) with professional buyers through Wilmet's intermediation.

s2.heading: 2. Access to the service
s2.body: Access to the partner area or the buyer area requires creating an account. The user agrees to provide accurate information and to keep their credentials confidential.

s3.heading: 3. Wilmet's role
s3.body: Wilmet acts as a commercial intermediary. The platform allows sales opportunities or purchase requests to be submitted, exchanged, and tracked through to completion. Wilmet does not own the vehicles offered by partners until a purchase agreement has been signed.

s4.heading: 4. User obligations
s4.item1: Provide truthful information about the vehicles offered (condition, mileage, history).
s4.item2: Not submit vehicles they do not have free disposal over.
s4.item3: Not use the platform for fraudulent or unlawful purposes.
s4.item4: Respect the confidentiality of commercial data exchanged.

s5.heading: 5. Suspension and termination
s5.body: Wilmet reserves the right to suspend or terminate any account in the event of a breach of these Terms of Use, in particular in the event of false information or fraudulent behaviour.

s6.heading: 6. Intellectual property
s6.body: The platform, its brand, code, design and editorial content are the exclusive property of Wilmet. Any unauthorised reproduction is prohibited.

s7.heading: 7. Applicable law and jurisdiction
s7.body: These Terms of Use are governed by French law. Any dispute falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Wilmet's registered office, unless mandatory law provides otherwise.

cgu.draftNotice: ⚠️ Template — to be reviewed by a lawyer before going into production.

cgv.title: Terms of Sale

s1.heading: 1. Scope
s1.body: These Terms of Sale apply to any commercial vehicle transaction concluded between Wilmet and a professional buyer through the Wilmet Trucks platform.

s2.heading: 2. Order and deposit
s2.body: An order becomes firm upon receipt of a signed purchase order and payment of a deposit, generally 20% of the price excluding tax, unless stated otherwise. The balance is settled before the vehicle is collected, or according to the terms specified in the purchase order.

s3.heading: 3. Price
s3.body: Prices are expressed in Euros (EUR), excluding tax. The applicable VAT and its regime (intra-EU reverse charge, margin scheme, etc.) are specified on each quote and invoice.

s4.heading: 4. Delivery and transfer of ownership
s4.body: Unless an express retention-of-title clause applies, ownership transfers upon full payment of the price. Transport and registration costs are borne by the buyer, unless otherwise agreed.

s5.heading: 5. Warranty
s5.body: Vehicles are sold used, as-is, with the statutory warranties applicable to sales between professionals. The buyer acknowledges having reviewed the vehicle's condition before signing.

s6.heading: 6. Right of withdrawal
s6.body: Sales between professionals are not eligible for the right of withdrawal provided for under the French Consumer Code.

s7.heading: 7. Disputes
s7.body: These Terms of Sale are governed by French law. Any dispute falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Wilmet's registered office.

cgv.draftNotice: ⚠️ Template — to be customised (deadlines, late-payment penalties, retention-of-title clause) and reviewed.

confidentialite.title: Privacy Policy

s1.heading: Data controller
s1.body: Wilmet, [address], is the data controller for the personal data collected via the Wilmet Trucks platform.

s2.heading: Data collected
s2.item1: Identity and contact details: name, surname, company, email, phone, address.
s2.item2: Professional data: role, history of opportunities and requests.
s2.item3: Connection data: logs, IP address, browser fingerprint.
s2.item4: Documents submitted: photos and documents relating to vehicles.

s3.heading: Purposes and legal basis
s3.item1: Performance of the service (contract): managing accounts, opportunities, transactions.
s3.item3: Legitimate interest: security, fraud prevention, platform improvement.

s4.heading: Retention periods
s4.item1: Active account: duration of the relationship + 3 years.

s5.heading: Sub-processors
s5.intro: Data is hosted within the European Union. Wilmet uses the following sub-processors, all bound by GDPR-compliant data processing agreements:
s5.item1: Lovable Cloud / Supabase — hosting, database, authentication.
s5.item3: Google Gemini via AI Gateway — matching analysis between offers and requests.

s6.heading: Your rights
s6.textBefore: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to, and port your data. To exercise these rights, write to
s6.textAfter: You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (French data protection authority).
